conversations.title: Blue and White Lines
conversations.description: Learn the difference between paid and free parking spots.

messages.text: Buongiorno! Cerca un posto per parcheggiare l'auto?
messages.english: Good morning! Are you looking for a place to park the car?

choices.text: Sì, cerco un parcheggio qui vicino. È difficile?
choices.english: Yes, I'm looking for a parking spot nearby. Is it difficult?
choices.feedback: Good. You confirmed your goal clearly.

choices.text: Ho fame, dove posso mangiare una pizza?
choices.english: I'm hungry, where can I eat a pizza?
choices.feedback: Wrong domain! Focus on parking.

choices.text: La mia macchina è rossa e molto veloce.
choices.english: My car is red and very fast.
choices.feedback: Irrelevant information for finding a spot.

messages.text: In centro è difficile. Vede quelle strisce blu e bianche per terra?
messages.english: It is difficult in the center. Do you see those blue and white lines on the ground?

choices.text: Sì, le vedo. Qual è la differenza tra blu e bianco?
choices.english: Yes, I see them. What is the difference between blue and white?
choices.feedback: Perfect question to understand the rules.

choices.text: Il cielo è blu e le nuvole sono bianche oggi.
choices.english: The sky is blue and the clouds are white today.
choices.feedback: Too literal! Focus on the parking lines.

choices.text: Mi piace il colore blu, è il mio preferito.
choices.english: I like the color blue, it's my favorite.
choices.feedback: Small talk won't help you park legally.

messages.text: Le strisce blu sono a pagamento. Quelle bianche sono gratuite.
messages.english: The blue lines are for paid parking. The white ones are free.

choices.text: Capisco. Allora cerco un posto con le strisce bianche.
choices.english: I understand. Then I'll look for a spot with white lines.
choices.feedback: Sensible choice if you want to save money.

choices.text: Voglio pagare molto per parcheggiare la mia auto.
choices.english: I want to pay a lot to park my car.
choices.feedback: Unlikely! Most people prefer free parking.

choices.text: Il bianco è un colore molto difficile da pulire.
choices.english: White is a very difficult color to clean.
choices.feedback: Irrelevant to the parking rules.

messages.text: Attenzione però. I posti bianchi sono quasi tutti occupati dai residenti.
messages.english: Watch out though. The white spots are almost all occupied by residents.

choices.text: Ah, peccato. Allora parcheggio sulle strisce blu, è meglio.
choices.english: Ah, too bad. Then I'll park on the blue lines, it's better.
choices.feedback: Correct. Adapting to the situation.

choices.text: Abito qui da molti anni, sono un residente anche io.
choices.english: I've lived here for many years, I'm a resident too.
choices.feedback: Don't lie! You are a visitor.

choices.text: Le strisce gialle sono molto belle da vedere qui.
choices.english: The yellow lines are very beautiful to see here.
choices.feedback: Yellow lines are for special categories, don't ignore the warning.

messages.text: Va bene. Ricordi di pagare alla macchinetta ed esporre il biglietto.
messages.english: Alright. Remember to pay at the machine and display the ticket.

choices.text: Certamente, vado subito a pagare. Grazie mille!
choices.english: Certainly, I'm going to pay right away. Thanks a lot!
choices.feedback: Polite and ready to follow instructions.

choices.text: Non voglio pagare, preferisco prendere una multa.
choices.english: I don't want to pay, I prefer to get a fine.
choices.feedback: Bad idea! Fines are expensive.

choices.text: Metto il biglietto in tasca per non perderlo.
choices.english: I'll put the ticket in my pocket so I don't lose it.
choices.feedback: No! You must display it on the dashboard.

messages.text: Prego. Attenzione, la macchinetta accetta solo monete o bancomat.
messages.english: You're welcome. Watch out, the machine only accepts coins or debit card.

choices.text: Va bene, ho le monete. Quanto costa all'ora?
choices.english: Alright, I have coins. How much does it cost per hour?
choices.feedback: Good question about the rate.

choices.text: Ho solo banconote grandi. Cambia i soldi?
choices.english: I only have large bills. Do you change money?
choices.feedback: Usually machines don't change big bills.

choices.text: Posso pagare con il mio telefono cellulare?
choices.english: Can I pay with my cell phone?
choices.feedback: Not at this specific machine, as mentioned by the host.

messages.text: Costa un euro e venti all'ora. Fino a che ora pensa di restare?
messages.english: It costs one euro and twenty per hour. Until what time do you plan to stay?

choices.text: Penso di restare fino alle tre del pomeriggio.
choices.english: I plan to stay until three in the afternoon.
choices.feedback: Clear answer about your duration.

choices.text: Resto solo per pochi minuti, vado veloce.
choices.english: I'm only staying for a few minutes, I'm going fast.
choices.feedback: Still need to pay for those minutes!

choices.text: Il parcheggio è aperto anche di notte?
choices.english: Is the parking open at night too?
choices.feedback: Focus on your current stay duration.

messages.text: Va bene. Allora deve inserire tre euro per coprire le tre ore.
messages.english: Alright. Then you must insert three euros to cover the three hours.

choices.text: D'accordo, inserisco i soldi adesso. Il biglietto esce qui?
choices.english: Agreed, I'm inserting the money now. Does the ticket come out here?
choices.feedback: Ready to pay and asking where the ticket is.

choices.text: Tre euro sono troppi per un'ora di sosta.
choices.english: Three euros is too much for an hour's stay.
choices.feedback: Actually it was for three hours, check the math.

choices.text: La macchinetta non restituisce il resto?
choices.english: Doesn't the machine give change?
choices.feedback: Focus on getting the ticket first.

messages.text: Sì, esce dalla fessura in basso. Non dimentichi di metterlo sul cruscotto.
messages.english: Yes, it comes out from the slot at the bottom. Don't forget to put it on the dashboard.

choices.text: Certo, lo metto bene in vista sul cruscotto. È tutto?
choices.english: Sure, I'll put it clearly visible on the dashboard. Is that all?
choices.feedback: Confirming the instruction and asking if finished.

choices.text: Metto il biglietto in tasca per sicurezza.
choices.english: I'll put the ticket in my pocket for safety.
choices.feedback: No! It must be visible for the inspector.

choices.text: Il cruscotto è troppo caldo oggi per la carta.
choices.english: The dashboard is too hot today for the paper.
choices.feedback: Irrelevant excuse, you must display it.

messages.text: Sì, è tutto a posto. Buona passeggiata in centro!
messages.english: Yes, everything is in order. Have a nice walk in the center!

choices.text: Grazie mille per l'aiuto, buona giornata!
choices.english: Thanks a lot for the help, have a good day!
choices.feedback: Polite closing of the interaction.

choices.text: Il centro è lontano da qui? Devo camminare?
choices.english: Is the center far from here? Do I have to walk?
choices.feedback: Host already implied you are going for a walk.

choices.text: Vado a cercare un altro posto più vicino.
choices.english: I'm going to look for another closer spot.
choices.feedback: But you just paid for this one!

conversations.title: The Parking Meter
conversations.description: How to use the machine and pay for your stay.

messages.text: Scusi, ha bisogno di aiuto con la macchinetta del parcheggio?
messages.english: Excuse me, do you need help with the parking machine?

choices.text: Sì, grazie. Non capisco come funziona questa macchinetta.
choices.english: Yes, thanks. I don't understand how this machine works.
choices.feedback: Good start. Admitting you need help is the first step.

choices.text: No, cerco un ristorante che fa dell'ottima pasta.
choices.english: No, I'm looking for a restaurant that makes great pasta.
choices.feedback: Wrong topic! You are at the parking meter.

choices.text: Questa macchinetta è molto vecchia e molto brutta.
choices.english: This machine is very old and very ugly.
choices.feedback: A bit rude! Just ask for help.

messages.text: È semplice. Prima deve inserire il numero di targa della sua auto.
messages.english: It's simple. First you must enter your car's license plate number.

choices.text: Va bene, inserisco la targa. Ecco fatto. E dopo?
choices.english: Alright, I'm entering the plate. Done. And then?
choices.feedback: Action taken and asking for the next step.

choices.text: Inserisco il mio numero di telefono nel computer.
choices.english: I'm entering my phone number into the computer.
choices.feedback: No, the machine needs the license plate.

choices.text: La mia targa è molto sporca, non riesco a leggerla.
choices.english: My plate is very dirty, I can't read it.
choices.feedback: Not helpful for completing the payment.

messages.text: Ora deve scegliere il tempo. Quanto tempo vuole restare?
messages.english: Now you must choose the time. How long do you want to stay?

choices.text: Voglio restare per due ore. Quanto costa il parcheggio?
choices.english: I want to stay for two hours. How much does parking cost?
choices.feedback: Clear goal and price inquiry.

choices.text: Resto qui per sempre, questa città è bellissima.
choices.english: I'm staying here forever, this city is beautiful.
choices.feedback: Unrealistic! Choose a specific time.

choices.text: Il tempo vola quando ci si diverte molto in vacanza.
choices.english: Time flies when you have a lot of fun on vacation.
choices.feedback: Philosophical but doesn't help with the machine.

messages.text: Costa un euro e cinquanta all'ora. Può pagare con monete o carta.
messages.english: It costs one euro and fifty per hour. You can pay with coins or card.

choices.text: Pago con la carta di credito. Devo inserirla qui?
choices.english: I'm paying by credit card. Do I have to insert it here?
choices.feedback: Correct identification of the payment method.

choices.text: Pago con un chilo di mele rosse e molto dolci.
choices.english: I'm paying with a kilo of red and very sweet apples.
choices.feedback: The machine only accepts money or cards!

choices.text: Non ho soldi, posso pagare con un grande sorriso?
choices.english: I don't have money, can I pay with a big smile?
choices.feedback: Machines don't appreciate smiles, only currency.

messages.text: Sì, esatto. Prema il tasto verde per confermare e ritiri la ricevuta.
messages.english: Yes, exactly. Press the green button to confirm and collect the receipt.

choices.text: Tasto verde... confermato. Ho preso la ricevuta, grazie!
choices.english: Green button... confirmed. I got the receipt, thanks!
choices.feedback: Success! You completed the payment process.

choices.text: Tasto rosso... ho annullato tutto per sbaglio.
choices.english: Red button... I cancelled everything by mistake.
choices.feedback: Wait! You need to pay, not cancel.

choices.text: La macchinetta ha mangiato la mia carta di credito.
choices.english: The machine ate my credit card.
choices.feedback: Hopefully not! Follow the instructions first.

messages.text: Ottimo. Adesso deve mettere la ricevuta all'interno dell'auto.
messages.english: Excellent. Now you must put the receipt inside the car.

choices.text: Sì, la metto subito sul cruscotto così è visibile.
choices.english: Yes, I'll put it on the dashboard right away so it's visible.
choices.feedback: Correct. Visibility is key for avoiding fines.

choices.text: Metto la ricevuta nel mio portafoglio nuovo.
choices.english: I'm putting the receipt in my new wallet.
choices.feedback: No, it must be in the car for the officer to see.

choices.text: L'auto è blu come il mare profondo.
choices.english: The car is blue like the deep sea.
choices.feedback: Keep your focus on the receipt.

messages.text: Esatto. Se scade il tempo e lei è ancora in giro, cosa fa?
messages.english: Exactly. If the time expires and you are still out, what do you do?

choices.text: Posso tornare qui e aggiungere altri soldi alla macchinetta?
choices.english: Can I come back here and add more money to the machine?
choices.feedback: Yes, that's one way to extend your stay.

choices.text: Scappo via molto velocemente per non prendere la multa.
choices.english: I run away very quickly so as not to get the fine.
choices.feedback: Better to just pay for more time!

choices.text: Il tempo è un concetto molto relativo e strano.
choices.english: Time is a very relative and strange concept.
choices.feedback: Not to the parking officer!

messages.text: Sì, oppure può usare un'app per pagare dal cellulare. La conosce?
messages.english: Yes, or you can use an app to pay from your phone. Do you know it?

choices.text: No, non la conosco. Come si chiama questa applicazione?
choices.english: No, I don't know it. What is this application called?
choices.feedback: Inquiring about modern payment methods.

choices.text: Il mio cellulare è rotto e non funziona più.
choices.english: My cell phone is broken and no longer works.
choices.feedback: Bad luck, but you can still use the machine.

choices.text: Le app sono piccole creature che vivono nel telefono.
choices.english: Apps are little creatures that live in the phone.
choices.feedback: That's a very creative but incorrect definition.

messages.text: Si chiama EasyPark. È molto comune qui in Italia.
messages.english: It's called EasyPark. It's very common here in Italy.

choices.text: Interessante, la scarico subito per la prossima volta.
choices.english: Interesting, I'll download it right away for next time.
choices.feedback: Good proactive approach for future parking.

choices.text: EasyPark sembra il nome di un parco divertimenti.
choices.english: EasyPark sounds like the name of an amusement park.
choices.feedback: It's actually for parking, not rollercoasters.

choices.text: Non mi piace scaricare niente, ho paura dei virus.
choices.english: I don't like downloading anything, I'm afraid of viruses.
choices.feedback: Official apps are generally safe.

messages.text: È un'ottima idea. Le farà risparmiare molto tempo.
messages.english: It's a great idea. It will save you a lot of time.

choices.text: Grazie per il consiglio, è stato molto gentile!
choices.english: Thanks for the advice, you were very kind!
choices.feedback: Polite end to the helpful conversation.

choices.text: Il tempo è denaro, ma io non ho né uno né l'altro.
choices.english: Time is money, but I have neither one nor the other.
choices.feedback: A bit pessimistic! Stay positive.

choices.text: Le idee sono come le stelle, brillano di notte.
choices.english: Ideas are like stars, they shine at night.
choices.feedback: Poetic but doesn't help with parking.

conversations.title: Parking Signs
conversations.description: Understand parking schedules and the 'disco orario' requirement.

messages.text: Attenzione! Ha letto il cartello prima di parcheggiare l'auto?
messages.english: Watch out! Did you read the sign before parking the car?

choices.text: No, non l'ho letto bene. Cosa dice il cartello?
choices.english: No, I didn't read it well. What does the sign say?
choices.feedback: Admitting you missed it is better than getting a fine.

choices.text: Sì, dice che posso parcheggiare qui per dieci giorni.
choices.english: Yes, it says I can park here for ten days.
choices.feedback: Unlikely! Parking signs are usually more restrictive.

choices.text: Il cartello è molto alto e io sono molto basso.
choices.english: The sign is very high and I am very short.
choices.feedback: Not a valid excuse for missing the rules.

messages.text: Dice che il parcheggio è riservato ai residenti dalle otto alle venti.
messages.english: It says that parking is reserved for residents from eight to twenty.

choices.text: Ah, capisco. Adesso sono le diciannove, quindi non posso?
choices.english: Ah, I see. Now it's nineteen, so I can't?
choices.feedback: Good calculation. You are checking the current time.

choices.text: Sono le otto di mattina, vado subito a dormire.
choices.english: It's eight in the morning, I'm going to sleep right away.
choices.feedback: Irrelevant! Focus on the parking restriction.

choices.text: Otto più venti fa ventotto, è un numero molto grande.
choices.english: Eight plus twenty makes twenty-eight, it's a very large number.
choices.feedback: Arithmetic won't help you park legally.

messages.text: Esatto. Però c'è un altro posto lì, dove serve il disco orario.
messages.english: Exactly. But there is another spot there, where you need a parking disc.

choices.text: Cos'è il disco orario? Non ne ho mai visto uno.
choices.english: What is a parking disc? I've never seen one.
choices.feedback: A very common and necessary question for tourists.

choices.text: Ho un disco di musica jazz in macchina, va bene?
choices.english: I have a jazz music disc in the car, is that okay?
choices.feedback: No! A 'disco orario' is for time, not music.

choices.text: Il mio orologio è rotto, non so che ore sono adesso.
choices.english: My watch is broken, I don't know what time it is now.
choices.feedback: You need to know the time to use a parking disc.

messages.text: È un cartoncino per indicare l'ora di arrivo. Si mette sul cruscotto.
messages.english: It's a small card to indicate the arrival time. You put it on the dashboard.

choices.text: Ah, ho capito. Posso restare solo per un'ora lì?
choices.english: Ah, I understand. Can I only stay for an hour there?
choices.feedback: Correct. Disco orario zones usually have a time limit.

choices.text: Metto il mio passaporto sul cruscotto della macchina.
choices.english: I'm putting my passport on the car's dashboard.
choices.feedback: No! That's dangerous and incorrect.

choices.text: Il mio cruscotto è pieno di polvere e di vecchie carte.
choices.english: My dashboard is full of dust and old papers.
choices.feedback: Not relevant to the parking disc explanation.

messages.text: Sì, massimo un'ora. Deve girare la ruota sull'ora di adesso.
messages.english: Yes, maximum one hour. You must turn the wheel to the current hour.

choices.text: Perfetto, lo faccio subito. Grazie per la spiegazione!
choices.english: Perfect, I'll do it right away. Thanks for the explanation!
choices.feedback: You've mastered the 'disco orario' concept.

choices.text: Giro la ruota della macchina verso sinistra o destra?
choices.english: Do I turn the car wheel to the left or right?
choices.feedback: He meant the wheel on the disc, not the steering wheel!

choices.text: Non ho voglia di girare niente, sono molto stanco.
choices.english: I don't feel like turning anything, I'm very tired.
choices.feedback: It only takes a second to avoid a fine!

messages.text: Prego. Si ricordi che dopo un'ora deve spostare la macchina.
messages.english: You're welcome. Remember that after one hour you must move the car.

choices.text: Va bene. E se resto più di un'ora rischio una multa?
choices.english: Alright. And if I stay more than an hour do I risk a fine?
choices.feedback: Correct concern. Time limits are strictly enforced.

choices.text: Sposto la macchina a mano perché sono molto forte.
choices.english: I'll move the car by hand because I am very strong.
choices.feedback: Unnecessary physical effort, just drive it!

choices.text: Il rischio è il mio mestiere preferito.
choices.english: Risk is my favorite job.
choices.feedback: Not when it comes to traffic fines!

messages.text: Sì, i vigili passano spesso a controllare i dischi orari.
messages.english: Yes, the traffic wardens often pass to check the parking discs.

choices.text: Capisco. Allora metto una sveglia sul mio telefono.
choices.english: I understand. Then I'll set an alarm on my phone.
choices.feedback: Smart way to remember when to return.

choices.text: I vigili sono persone molto simpatiche e allegre.
choices.english: The wardens are very nice and cheerful people.
choices.feedback: Maybe, but they will still give you a ticket.

choices.text: La sveglia suona sempre troppo presto la mattina.
choices.english: The alarm always rings too early in the morning.
choices.feedback: This is for your parking time, not for waking up.

messages.text: È un'ottima idea. Sa dove si comprano questi dischi orari?
messages.english: It's a great idea. Do you know where these parking discs are bought?

choices.text: No, non lo so. Si trovano in tabaccheria?
choices.english: No, I don't know. Can they be found in the tobacco shop?
choices.feedback: Correct. Tabaccherias sell many useful items.

choices.text: Si comprano in farmacia insieme alle medicine?
choices.english: Are they bought in the pharmacy along with medicines?
choices.feedback: No, pharmacies are for health needs.

choices.text: Non voglio comprare niente, preferisco riceverli in regalo.
choices.english: I don't want to buy anything, I prefer to receive them as a gift.
choices.feedback: Unlikely to get one as a gift on the street.

messages.text: Sì, in tabaccheria o nelle edicole. Costano pochi euro.
messages.english: Yes, in the tobacco shop or at the newsstands. They cost a few euros.

choices.text: Va bene, ne compro uno così sono tranquillo.
choices.english: Alright, I'll buy one so I'm at peace.
choices.feedback: Wise investment to avoid higher costs.

choices.text: Le edicole vendono solo giornali vecchi e polverosi.
choices.english: Newsstands only sell old and dusty newspapers.
choices.feedback: Not true, they have many useful things for travelers.

choices.text: Sono molto povero e non ho nemmeno un euro.
choices.english: I'm very poor and I don't even have one euro.
choices.feedback: Then parking a car might be difficult anyway.

messages.text: Ben fatto. È meglio spendere due euro che prendere una multa cara.
messages.english: Well done. It's better to spend two euros than to get an expensive fine.

choices.text: Hai ragione. Grazie ancora per tutti i consigli!
choices.english: You're right. Thanks again for all the advice!
choices.feedback: Finalizing the conversation with agreement.

choices.text: Le multe sono regali che lo Stato fa ai cittadini.
choices.english: Fines are gifts that the State makes to citizens.
choices.feedback: That's a very unusual way to see a fine!

choices.text: La ragione è dei fessi, io preferisco avere torto.
choices.english: Reason is for fools, I prefer to be wrong.
choices.feedback: Not a helpful attitude for legal parking.

conversations.title: Free Parking
conversations.description: Checking if parking is free on holidays and Sundays.

messages.text: Buongiorno. Sta cercando di pagare il parcheggio oggi?
messages.english: Good morning. Are you trying to pay for parking today?

choices.text: Sì, ma la macchinetta non accetta le mie monete.
choices.english: Yes, but the machine doesn't accept my coins.
choices.feedback: Good observation. Reporting a technical issue.

choices.text: No, sto cercando di comprare un biglietto del treno.
choices.english: No, I'm trying to buy a train ticket.
choices.feedback: Wrong machine! This is for parking.

choices.text: Le mie monete sono molto lucide e molto pesanti.
choices.english: My coins are very shiny and very heavy.
choices.feedback: Irrelevant to the payment problem.

messages.text: Ma oggi è domenica! Lo sa che la domenica il parcheggio è gratis?
messages.english: But today is Sunday! Do you know that on Sundays parking is free?

choices.text: Davvero? È gratis tutto il giorno o solo la mattina?
choices.english: Really? Is it free all day or only in the morning?
choices.feedback: Excellent follow-up question for clarity.

choices.text: La domenica mi piace dormire fino a tardi a casa.
choices.english: On Sundays I like to sleep late at home.
choices.feedback: Irrelevant to the free parking information.

choices.text: Oggi è lunedì, ho controllato sul mio calendario.
choices.english: Today is Monday, I checked my calendar.
choices.feedback: Don't argue! The host is giving you good news.

messages.text: È gratis per tutto il giorno festivo. Non deve mettere soldi.
messages.english: It is free for the entire holiday. You don't have to put money in.

choices.text: Che bella notizia! Vale per tutte le zone della città?
choices.english: What great news! Does it apply to all areas of the city?
choices.feedback: Smart. Some zones might have different rules.

choices.text: Voglio mettere i soldi lo stesso perché sono generoso.
choices.english: I want to put the money anyway because I am generous.
choices.feedback: Unnecessary! Save your money for a gelato.

choices.text: La città è molto grande e io mi perdo sempre.
choices.english: The city is very big and I always get lost.
choices.feedback: Stay focused on the parking rules.

messages.text: Quasi tutte, tranne vicino all'ospedale e alla stazione.
messages.english: Almost all, except near the hospital and the station.

choices.text: Siamo lontani dalla stazione qui, vero?
choices.english: We are far from the station here, right?
choices.feedback: Confirming your current location relative to exceptions.

choices.text: Prendo il treno per andare a Roma domani mattina.
choices.english: I'm taking the train to go to Rome tomorrow morning.
choices.feedback: Irrelevant to the current parking situation.

choices.text: L'ospedale è un posto molto triste per molte persone.
choices.english: The hospital is a very sad place for many people.
choices.feedback: A bit too dark! Keep it practical.

messages.text: Sì, siamo in centro. Può lasciare l'auto qui senza problemi.
messages.english: Yes, we are in the center. You can leave the car here without problems.

choices.text: Ottimo, allora la lascio qui. Grazie per l'informazione!
choices.english: Great, then I'll leave it here. Thanks for the information!
choices.feedback: Perfect. You saved money and found a spot.

choices.text: La mia macchina è molto vecchia e non parte più.
choices.english: My car is very old and no longer starts.
choices.feedback: Then you have a bigger problem than parking!

choices.text: Vado a piedi perché mi piace molto camminare.
choices.english: I'm going on foot because I like walking very much.
choices.feedback: But you just parked your car here!

messages.text: Di nulla. Sa se ci sono restrizioni per la pulizia delle strade?
messages.english: You're welcome. Do you know if there are restrictions for street cleaning?

choices.text: Pulizia delle strade? No, non ne so nulla. Cosa succede?
choices.english: Street cleaning? No, I don't know anything about it. What happens?
choices.feedback: Good question about a common Italian rule.

choices.text: Mi piace molto pulire la mia casa ogni sabato.
choices.english: I like cleaning my house very much every Saturday.
choices.feedback: Personal habits are not relevant here.

choices.text: Le strade sono fatte di asfalto grigio e duro.
choices.english: The streets are made of gray and hard asphalt.
choices.feedback: Irrelevant observation.

messages.text: In alcune notti passano i camion a pulire e non si può parcheggiare.
messages.english: On some nights trucks pass to clean and you cannot park.

choices.text: Ah, devo controllare i cartelli per vedere i giorni e gli orari?
choices.english: Ah, do I have to check the signs to see the days and times?
choices.feedback: Correct. Cleaning schedules are posted on signs.

choices.text: I camion sono molto grandi e fanno molto rumore.
choices.english: The trucks are very large and make a lot of noise.
choices.feedback: Irrelevant comment about trucks.

choices.text: Non dormo mai di notte, guardo sempre la luna.
choices.english: I never sleep at night, I always look at the moon.
choices.feedback: Not helpful for parking regulations.

messages.text: Sì, di solito c'è un cartello piccolo sotto quello del parcheggio.
messages.english: Yes, usually there is a small sign below the parking one.

choices.text: Controllo subito. Non vorrei che portassero via la macchina.
choices.english: I'm checking right away. I wouldn't want them to take the car away.
choices.feedback: Wise to avoid the towing risk.

choices.text: I cartelli piccoli sono difficili da leggere per me.
choices.english: Small signs are difficult for me to read.
choices.feedback: You must read them to avoid fines.

choices.text: La mia macchina sa volare, quindi non mi preoccupo.
choices.english: My car can fly, so I don't worry.
choices.feedback: Fantasy won't save you from the traffic warden.

messages.text: Se c'è il simbolo del carro attrezzi, la portano via davvero.
messages.english: If there is the tow truck symbol, they really take it away.

choices.text: Meno male che me l'ha detto! Controllo con molta attenzione.
choices.english: Thank goodness you told me! I'll check very carefully.
choices.feedback: Grateful and cautious, good attitude.

choices.text: Il carro attrezzi è un veicolo molto colorato.
choices.english: The tow truck is a very colorful vehicle.
choices.feedback: Its color doesn't matter if it takes your car!

choices.text: Non ho paura di niente, nemmeno del buio.
choices.english: I'm not afraid of anything, not even the dark.
choices.feedback: Bravado won't help with a towed car.

messages.text: Meglio così. Godetevi la domenica senza preoccupazioni!
messages.english: Better that way. Enjoy your Sunday without worries!

choices.text: Grazie mille, farò così. Buona domenica anche a lei!
choices.english: Thanks a lot, I'll do that. Good Sunday to you too!
choices.feedback: Polite end to the interaction.

choices.text: La domenica è il giorno più noioso della settimana.
choices.english: Sunday is the most boring day of the week.
choices.feedback: That's a matter of opinion, not parking.

choices.text: Le preoccupazioni sono come le nuvole, passano presto.
choices.english: Worries are like clouds, they pass soon.
choices.feedback: Philosophical but unrelated to the topic.
